#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, b;
    std::cin >> n >> b;
    std::vector<int> arr(n);
    std::vector<int> val(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> arr[i];
        val[i] = (arr[i] % 2 == 0) ? -1 : 1;
    }

    int sum = 0;
    std::vector<int> cost;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        sum += val[i];
        if (sum == 0) {
            int diff = std::abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]);
            cost.push_back(diff);
        }
    }

    std::sort(cost.begin(), cost.end());

    int totalCost = 0;
    int maxPoints = 0;
    for (int c : cost) {
        if (totalCost + c <= b) {
            totalCost += c;
            ++maxPoints;
        }
    }

    std::cout << maxPoints << "\n";

    return 0;
}
